summary: Co-working locker delivery mismatch blocking new-hire desk builds and badge provisioning
description: Issue summary: Three new-hire kits (3 laptops + 3 docks + 3 headsets) were delivered by vendor to the satellite co-working address but were placed in lockers with incorrect locker IDs. The courier marked them delivered and left; the vendor tracking now shows 'delivered - locker 12B' but the co-working site only has lockers 1-10. Impact: Desk build and badge provisioning for 3 hires scheduled for 2026-03-11 cannot proceed. New hires are remote-first but require hardware and a temporary desk for first-week onboarding. Badges for the co-working site have not been provisioned because the asset tags are not in inventory. Environment: production shipping flow for company-owned assets to third-party co-working site (vendor: QuickBox Logistics, manifest QBL-20260309-77). Steps to reproduce / observed sequence: 1) HR/Onboarding created shipping manifest and selected co-working locker delivery option; 2) QuickBox courier scanned manifest and reported delivery to locker 12B; 3) Onsite co-working contact reports only lockers 1-10 exist and cannot locate packages; 4) Inventory still shows assets assigned to 'Unshipped' until vendor updated status; 5) Badge provisioning blocked because serials not yet scanned into Redwood asset inventory. Initial logs/attachments: - Vendor tracking: https://tracking.quickbox.example/QBL-20260309-77 - Shipping manifest (HR): https://s3.redwood.company/onboarding/manifests/2026-03/QBL-20260309-77.csv - Onsite note (Slack): #facilities thread https://slack.redwood.company/archives/C04FACIL/ PM12345 - Devices affected: 3x RWD-DevGen14-Laptop (asset tags: TBD in manifest), 3x RWD-DK07 docks, 3x RWD-HS03 headsets. Desired outcome: Retrieve the assets from vendor/co-working site, update inventory and badge provisioning so desk builds can be completed on 2026-03-12, and put an immediate short-term fix in the delivery SOP to prevent locker-ID mismatches.
steps_to_reproduce: Create shipping manifest selecting co-working locker delivery option
Vendor picks up kit and sets delivery type to 'locker' in TMS
Courier scans and updates delivered locker ID in vendor app
Onsite co-working manager checks lockers and reports mismatch
Inventory and badge provisioning processes remain blocked because serials not scanned

Desk builds scheduled for 2026-03-12 AM. Follow-up: Update shipping SOP to validate locker ID mapping between QuickBox and co-working partner before dispatch; add a pre-shipment confirmation step in HR onboarding checklist. Owner for SOP update: Liam O'Connor.
